response.sql:
WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
  FROM Examination AS e
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY p.SEX
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(patient_count) AS combined_count,
         AVG(1.0 * patient_count) AS average_count
  FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT SUM(s.patient_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(1.0 * s.patient_count / t.combined_count) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.patient_count - t.average_count) AS average_excess
FROM sex_counts AS s
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
WHERE s.patient_count > t.average_count;

assumptions.assumption: A blank sex means the empty string; NULL is a separate group. The query treats whitespace-only values as their own distinct SEX values.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat whitespace-only SEX values as blank too, while keeping NULL separate.
alternatives.sql:
WITH sex_counts AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END AS sex_group,
         COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS patient_count
  FROM Examination AS e
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY CASE WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.SEX END
), totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(patient_count) AS combined_count,
         AVG(1.0 * patient_count) AS average_count
  FROM sex_counts
)
SELECT SUM(s.patient_count) AS total_count,
       AVG(1.0 * s.patient_count / t.combined_count) AS average_share,
       AVG(s.patient_count - t.average_count) AS average_excess
